أستنجد (form X)
# أَسْتَنْجِدُ (ʔastanjidu) /ʔas.tan.d͡ʒi.du/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِسْتَنْجَدَ (istanjada)
# أُسْتَنْجَدُ (ʔustanjadu) /ʔus.tan.d͡ʒa.du/: first-person singular non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَنْجَدَ (istanjada)
# أَسْتَنْجِدَ (ʔastanjida) /ʔas.tan.d͡ʒi.da/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَنْجَدَ (istanjada)
# أُسْتَنْ
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
